narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.48 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.6191-0.6242 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.6273; the first objective pays 1.14R at 0.6161.

plan.triggerRule: footprint trap fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.6273 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

basis.coinbaseReason: Coinbase premium tracked for BTC/ETH/SOL only

notes: taker buyVolUsd/sellVolUsd = Binance base-asset taker volume converted at the perp last price
funding: no per-venue OI available — oiWeightedRate8h is the equal-weight mean
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
